disposition.note: "est marker" sits 1.05-1.07pt right of Word: Word kerns the T-e pair (e at 88.03pt against our 89.10pt) in this package without a styles part, while the run states no w:kern. The 150 DPI crop shows the same glyphs, outlines and weight, offset by one pair kern; "T" matches at 80.55pt against 80.525pt. Sub-material, recorded under #1874.
